# Pirated ships

Every ship that becomes mine is marked pirated if I took it in combat, by boarding or by its crew bailing, and is a donation otherwise, so booty pays the stolen bonus only for piracy.

Source: [`tests/game/features/pirated-ships.feature`](../../tests/game/features/pirated-ships.feature) · Spec: [`docs/specs/pirated-ships.md`](../specs/pirated-ships.md)

| Unit tests | Game tests | Manual | Pending | By hand |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 3 | 1 | 0 | **1** |

## Scenarios

### A ship that bailed to me and that I claim is pirated

**Automated:** in game `pirated_bail_then_claim`

```gherkin
  Given a capturable Argon fighter whose pilot bails while one of my ships attacks it
  When I claim the abandoned fighter
  Then it's marked pirated, by bail, from the Argon
```

### A ship I board is pirated

**Automated:** in game `pirated_boarding`

```gherkin
  Given my boarding operation on an Argon frigate
  When the frigate becomes mine
  Then it's marked pirated, by boarding, from the Argon
```

### A ship docked at a ship I board is pirated

- [ ] **Manual:** checked by hand for now

```gherkin
  Given a capturable ship docked at a carrier
  When my boarding operation takes the carrier
  Then the docked ship becomes mine too, marked pirated by boarding
```

### Claiming a ship abandoned without me is a donation

**Automated:** in game `pirated_claim_without_bail`

```gherkin
  Given an abandoned fighter that never bailed to me
  When I claim it
  Then it isn't marked pirated
```
